justification: Inspected the exact `package foo;` files under `javaparser-symbol-solver-testing/src/test/resources` (`issue1456/foo/A.java`, `issue1769/foo/OtherClass.java`, `issue276/foo/{A,B,C}.java`, `issue2951/foo/A.java`, `issue2953/foo/{A,IB}.java`, `issue4358/foo/{A,B}.java`, `issue128/foo/Issue128.java`, `issue4846/foo/Main.java`, `EmptyVarargsCallTest/Foo.java`, `NotQuiteCyclicParent.java.txt`). The only concrete in-repo package dependency into `foo` I found is `issue1456/bar/A.java` (`package bar; public class A extends foo.A`), while the only concrete outward package dependency from `foo` is the reverse edge in `NotQuiteCyclicParent.java.txt` (`extends bar.NotQuiteCyclicParent`); the other `foo` files are self-contained or only reference other `foo` types, with `issue2951/foo/A.java` only importing `java.util.List`. This does not show `foo` depending on a package that is clearly less stable than itself.
